'''Amadaine 2 (June 9)'''

==Events==
* [[998 NE]] - The [[Amyrlin]]'s party reaches [[Fal Dara]]. The keep is attacked and [[Fain]] escapes with [[Mat]]'s dagger and the [[Horn of Valere]].
* [[998 NE]] - [[Geofram Bornhald]] meets with [[Questioners]] in the village of [[Alcruna]].
* [[999 NE]] - [[Perrin]]'s party emerges in the [[Manetheren]] [[Waygate]]. In the wolf dream, he finds [[Slayer]] and follows him to the [[Tower of Ghenjei]].
